title: The People Behind the Prophy: Spotlighting Dental Hygienists, Episode 2
html:
Dental hygienists do far more than clean teeth. They educate, advocate, build trust with patients and play an important role in preventive oral healthcare, often while adapting to the individual needs of the people they serve.

The People Behind the Prophy was created by Henry Schein to put those professionals and their stories center stage. Moving beyond the technical “prophy,” Henry Schein is spotlighting the people behind dental hygiene and exploring the experiences, skills, and human connections that shape their work.

In Episode 2 of The People Behind the Prophy, pediatric dental hygienist Kimberly Kyd, RDH, shares how patience, prevention, and a whole-patient approach can help children build a positive relationship with dental care.

From her own dental health journey to helping the children and families she serves, Kyd’s compassion is making a lasting impact. This pediatric dental hygienist is sharing her tips for creating positive dental experiences, the importance of recognizing airway concerns early, turning fear into confidence, and more.

Click here to view the full episode where Kimberly shares her approach to pediatric care.

Her story underscores the broader message behind The People Behind the Prophy and is the second installment of Henry Schein’s series highlighting the people and impact behind the dental hygiene profession.
